title: Superman World of New Krypton #1 DC 2009 Gary Frank Cover Robinson Rucka Woods
condition_description: Bright, clean covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Superman: World of New Krypton #1 (May 2009), DC Comics - first issue. Superman makes a new life on New Krypton. Written by James Robinson and Greg Rucka, art by Pete Woods; cover by Gary Frank. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Wonder Woman animated movie DVD ad.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
